title: National Peanut Brittle Day
body: January 26 is National Peanut Brittle Day, which is a very specific excuse to celebrate the old-school candy made from caramelized sugar and peanuts.

title: National Kite Flying Day
body: February 8 is National Kite Flying Day, a wonderfully optimistic thing to put on a winter calendar even if the weather has other ideas.

title: Pokémon Day
body: February 27 is Pokémon Day. The date traces back to the original Pokémon Red and Green games launching in Japan on February 27, 1996; in 2026 the franchise celebrated its 30th anniversary.
notes: Whimsical cousin-birthday exact-date fact; checked against official Pokémon material 2026-08-19.

title: National Deep Dish Pizza Day
body: April 5 is National Deep Dish Pizza Day, celebrating the gloriously over-engineered style of pizza where the crust behaves more like architecture.

title: National Tell a Story Day
body: April 27 is National Tell a Story Day, which is almost suspiciously well suited to a family birthday page: old stories, exaggerated stories, and stories everyone has heard twelve times all count.

title: National Gummi Bear Day
body: April 27 also lands on National Gummi Bear Day, because apparently one whimsical observance was not enough for this birthday.

title: National Mac and Cheese Day
body: July 14 is National Mac and Cheese Day, giving Bastille Day some extremely cheesy competition on the family calendar.

title: World Emoji Day 📅
body: July 17 is World Emoji Day. The date was chosen because July 17 appears on the calendar emoji on major platforms, turning a tiny phone icon into its own annual celebration.
